title: DIMER timm model artifact manifest
description: Ships as `model_manifest.json` inside a DIMER ModelVersion, next to the weights. It is the authoritative description of a fine-tuned timm classifier: architecture identifier, classifier width, ordered class names, which checkpoint file and which weights within it to load, and the exact inference preprocessing. The worker (dimer-inference-service-timm) is a deterministic loader driven by this file; it does not infer training decisions from the checkpoint. Cross-field invariant enforced by the worker and not expressible here: len(class_names) == num_classes == model logits width.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Optional in v1; reserved for future migrations.

framework.description: Only timm artifacts are accepted by this worker.

model.description: A local timm registry identifier: `architecture` or `architecture.tag` (e.g. `resnet50`, `resnet50.a1_in1k`). Tags are allowed and useful: timm resolves them into pretrained_cfg even with pretrained=False. Remote and path-like sources (`hf-hub:`, `local-dir:`, `/`, `\`, `@`) are rejected by the pattern and again by the worker.

num_classes.description: Width of the classifier head in the checkpoint. Required: timm constructs the model before loading weights with strict=True, so the head width cannot be inferred. 0 (backbone-only) is refused in v1.

class_names.description: Ordered label strings, index-aligned with the classifier outputs. Must have exactly num_classes entries. A property of the trained artifact — never supplied per request.

checkpoint.description: Bare filename of the weights file in the same directory. `.safetensors` preferred. Loaded with strict=True and torch weights_only=True; pickled-object checkpoints will fail.

use_ema.description: When true and the checkpoint contains `state_dict_ema` or `model_ema`, load those. When false, load `state_dict`/`model`/raw weights even if EMA weights are present. Explicit because timm's own loader silently prefers EMA by default. The worker records which key it actually used in the output provenance.

preprocessing.description: The effective inference transform used during fine-tuning. Persisted because resolve_data_config() reconstructs architecture DEFAULTS from pretrained_cfg, not what training actually used; a mismatch degrades predictions silently rather than failing.

input_size.description: [channels, height, width]. channels must be 3 in v1: the worker converts every input to RGB, so grayscale/multispectral checkpoints are refused at manifest validation rather than failing per image.

mean.description: Per-channel normalization mean; length must equal input_size[0].

std.description: Per-channel normalization std; length must equal input_size[0].

crop_pct.description: Center-crop fraction applied after resize (timm eval convention). When omitted, the worker resolves it from the model's own pretrained_cfg via timm.data.resolve_data_config (the architecture/tag value, e.g. 0.95 for resnet50.a1_in1k) and records crop_pct_source=model_cfg in the output provenance. It does NOT fall through to timm's library-wide 0.875 default. State it explicitly whenever fine-tuning used a different value.

crop_mode.description: timm eval crop mode. Defaults to center when omitted.
